strings.text: {files} in one folder — a folder is one world, one game or one article
strings.translation: {files} en una misma carpeta: una carpeta es un mundo, un juego o un artículo

strings.text: not JSON: {error}
strings.translation: no es JSON: {error}

strings.text: not an object
strings.translation: no es un objeto

strings.text: "languages" — the languages it is in: a list of moood's ({known})
strings.translation: "languages": los idiomas en que está; una lista de los de moood ({known})

strings.text: "languages" — {languages}: not moood's ({known})
strings.translation: "languages": {languages} no son de moood ({known})

strings.text: "languages" — {languages} twice
strings.translation: "languages": {languages} dos veces

strings.text: "{field}" {ref} — not a path
strings.translation: "{field}" {ref}: no es una ruta

strings.text: "{field}" {ref} — {name}: not a repository (owner/name)
strings.translation: "{field}" {ref}: {name} no es un repositorio (propietario/nombre)

strings.text: "{field}" {ref} — {version}: not a branch, a tag or a commit
strings.translation: "{field}" {ref}: {version} no es una rama, una etiqueta ni un commit

strings.text: "{field}" {ref} — {path}: not a path in the repository (. — its root)
strings.translation: "{field}" {ref}: {path} no es una ruta del repositorio (. es su raíz)

strings.text: "{field}" {ref} — neither a path from here nor repo@ref:path
strings.translation: "{field}" {ref}: ni una ruta desde aquí ni repo@ref:path

strings.text: "{field}" {ref} — out of the repository
strings.translation: "{field}" {ref}: fuera del repositorio

strings.text: "world" — the world it is played on: a path from here, or repo@ref:path
strings.translation: "world": el mundo en que se juega; una ruta desde aquí o repo@ref:path

strings.text: "{field}" {ref} — no world there ({file})
strings.translation: "{field}" {ref}: ahí no hay ningún mundo ({file})

strings.text: "{field}" {ref} — its world is not in {languages}: a game is in a language only if its world is
strings.translation: "{field}" {ref}: su mundo no está en {languages}; un juego está en un idioma solo si su mundo lo está

strings.text: "about" — a list of the worlds, games and scenes it is about (paths from here, or repo@ref:path)
strings.translation: "about": una lista de los mundos, juegos y escenas de que trata (rutas desde aquí o repo@ref:path)

strings.text: "about" {ref} — no world, game or scene there
strings.translation: "about" {ref}: ahí no hay ningún mundo, juego ni escena

strings.text: "engine" {engine} — there is engine 3 (every new scene), and engine 1 (a scene that says none)
strings.translation: "engine" {engine}: existe el motor 3 (toda escena nueva) y el motor 1 (una escena que no dice ninguno)

strings.text: "engine" 2 — engine 2 is gone: the scene is written anew for engine 3 ("engine": 3)
strings.translation: "engine" 2: el motor 2 ya no existe; la escena se escribe de nuevo para el motor 3 ("engine": 3)

strings.text: "music" — {count} descriptions that sound: {most} at most
strings.translation: "music": {count} descripciones que suenan; como mucho {most}

strings.text: "music" — the description {n} that sounds: {length} characters, {most} at most
strings.translation: "music": la descripción {n} que suena tiene {length} caracteres; como mucho {most}

strings.text: "music".{field} {value} — {least} to {most}
strings.translation: "music".{field} {value}: de {least} a {most}

strings.text: "music".scale "{scale}" — one of {scales}
strings.translation: "music".scale "{scale}": una de {scales}

strings.text: does not read as JavaScript: {error}
strings.translation: no se lee como JavaScript: {error}

strings.text: tr(…) — its text is not a literal
strings.translation: tr(…): su texto no es un literal

strings.text: tr.n(count, one, other) — its forms are not literals
strings.translation: tr.n(count, one, other): sus formas no son literales

strings.text: tr.c(context, text) — not literals
strings.translation: tr.c(context, text): no son literales

strings.text: tr.{name}(who, text) — not literals
strings.translation: tr.{name}(who, text): no son literales

strings.text: tr.{name} — not for a world's or a game's code (tr, tr.n, tr.c, tr.line, tr.thought)
strings.translation: tr.{name}: no es para el código de un mundo o de un juego (tr, tr.n, tr.c, tr.line, tr.thought)

strings.text: tr`…` — call it: tr('…')
strings.translation: tr`…`: llámalo así: tr('…')

strings.text: tr — not a value (T = tr, f(tr)): call it where its text is written
strings.translation: tr no es un valor (T = tr, f(tr)): llámalo donde está escrito su texto

strings.text: {name} is the language's own name — not a variable
strings.translation: {name} es un nombre propio del lenguaje: no una variable

strings.text: {name} is the language's own name — not a function
strings.translation: {name} es un nombre propio del lenguaje: no una función

strings.text: {name} is the language's own name — not to be set
strings.translation: {name} es un nombre propio del lenguaje: no se le asigna valor

strings.text: {name} is the language's own name — not a parameter
strings.translation: {name} es un nombre propio del lenguaje: no un parámetro

strings.text: person(who).{name}(text) — not literals
strings.translation: person(who).{name}(text): no son literales

strings.text: act(who, 'say', text) — a game's line is b.say(who, text)
strings.translation: act(who, 'say', text): una réplica de un juego es b.say(who, text)

strings.text: act(who, 'say', text) — not literals
strings.translation: act(who, 'say', text): no son literales

strings.text: {name}(who, text) — the text written here, its speaker not: a line is said by someone written beside it ({name}('who', '…'))
strings.translation: {name}(who, text): el texto está escrito aquí, quien lo dice no; una réplica la dice alguien escrito a su lado ({name}('who', '…'))

strings.text: .{name}('…') — whose line it is is not written beside it: s.person('who').{name}('…'), or s.{name}('who', '…')
strings.translation: .{name}('…'): de quién es la réplica no está escrito a su lado; s.person('who').{name}('…') o s.{name}('who', '…')

strings.text: {name}(who, text) — a text in it is not a line: write it whole here, or mark each where it is written (tr.line, tr.thought)
strings.translation: {name}(who, text): un texto en él no es una réplica; escríbela entera aquí o marca cada una donde está escrita (tr.line, tr.thought)

strings.text: {name}(who, line, { how, spoken }) — a kept line's own manner and spoken words are kept with it: tr.line(who, text, { how, spoken })
strings.translation: {name}(who, line, { how, spoken }) — la manera propia y las palabras habladas de una línea guardada se guardan con ella: tr.line(who, text, { how, spoken })

strings.text: {name} — its voice, how are not literals
strings.translation: {name}: su voice y how no son literales

strings.text: {name} — its how is not a literal
strings.translation: {name}: su how no es un literal

strings.text: {name} — its spoken is not a literal
strings.translation: {name} — su spoken no es un literal

strings.text: {name} — "who" is not heard: a voice is {voice, how}
strings.translation: {name}: "who" no se oye; una voz es {voice, how}

strings.text: {name} — its voice is spread (…): say it whole, in literals
strings.translation: {name}: su voz está desplegada (…); escríbela entera, en literales

strings.text: {name} — a game's line is heard in its person's voice (people.json): its own is { how }
strings.translation: {name}: una réplica de un juego se oye con la voz de su persona (people.json); lo propio suyo es solo { how }

strings.text: "{text}" — a { name } in a text shown as it is (nothing goes into it)
strings.translation: "{text}": un { name } en un texto que se muestra tal cual (no se le inserta nada)

strings.text: {field} — not a text
strings.translation: {field}: no es un texto

strings.text: not {"strings": [entries]}
strings.translation: no es {"strings": [entradas]}

strings.text: "{text}" — translated twice
strings.translation: "{text}": traducido dos veces

strings.text: none — {n} text to translate into {lang}

translation.many: ninguno: {n} de textos por traducir a {lang}

strings.text: "{text}" — not translated
strings.translation: "{text}": sin traducir

strings.text: "{text}" — not translated (its forms: {forms})
strings.translation: "{text}": sin traducir (sus formas: {forms})

strings.text: "{text}" — no "{form}" form
strings.translation: "{text}": falta la forma "{form}"

strings.text: "{text}" — its "{form}" form says {{names}}, the text {{wanted}} (and { n }, or not)
strings.translation: "{text}": su forma "{form}" dice {{names}}, el texto {{wanted}} (y { n }, o no)

strings.text: "{text}" — the translation says {{names}}, the text {{wanted}}
strings.translation: "{text}": la traducción dice {{names}}, el texto {{wanted}}

strings.text: "{text}" — the translation's tags are {tags}, the line's {wanted} (heard as written, in English)
strings.translation: "{text}": las etiquetas de la traducción son {tags}, las de la réplica {wanted} (se oyen como están escritas, en inglés)

strings.text: "{text}" — the code no longer says it (check --write lays the file out anew)
strings.translation: "{text}": el código ya no lo dice (check --write vuelve a disponer el archivo)

strings.text: its data ({files}) is not the source's ({wanted})
strings.translation: sus datos ({files}) no son los del idioma de origen ({wanted})

strings.text: "{who}" — not {voice, how, short}
strings.translation: "{who}": no es {voice, how, short}

strings.text: "{who}".{field} — a person is {voice, how, short}
strings.translation: "{who}".{field}: una persona es {voice, how, short}

strings.text: "{who}".name — a person is {voice, how, short} (who they are is their voice and their manner)
strings.translation: "{who}".name: una persona es {voice, how, short} (quién es, son su voz y su manera)

strings.text: "{who}".{field} — not a text
strings.translation: "{who}".{field}: no es un texto

strings.text: "{text}" — said by "{who}", no one of {people}
strings.translation: "{text}": lo dice "{who}", que no es nadie de {people}

strings.text: "{text}" — thought by "{who}", who has no short name ({people})
strings.translation: "{text}": lo piensa "{who}", que no tiene nombre corto ({people})

strings.text: no "title" and "date"
strings.translation: faltan "title" y "date"

strings.text: none — the article's text
strings.translation: falta: el texto del artículo

strings.text: none — the article in {lang}
strings.translation: falta: el artículo en {lang}

strings.text: no "title" — the article in {lang}
strings.translation: falta "title": el artículo en {lang}

strings.text: no "summary"
strings.translation: falta "summary"

strings.text: none — the article's text in {lang}
strings.translation: falta: el texto del artículo en {lang}
